== Build notes: 2008 MPC Sunday consolation ==

Added fifth place in the Sunday consolation event on 6 January 2008, from the numbered final standings.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation results], Players Committee Forums.</ref> The format is [[Premiere - Original VS14]]. No dropped marker is listed. Existing tournament rows, deck links, card credits and this Talk page's earlier note are retained.

The source check reused ten cached native DeckTech pages after their complete bytes matched both the current original-domain responses and independently restored existing Git copies. Three existing PDF copies were likewise reused after full original-URL stream and independent Git checks. Their Ryan French sheets were read directly: 2007 Day 2 page 4, 2008 Day 2 page 27 and 2008 Team page 20. The current 2025 Worlds source also lists Ryan in 47th place with ASM and WYS, matching the existing row. No new historical interpretation or personal relationship was added.

The exact sources, drafts and live revisions have independent backups and central preservation records. External captures remain pending with the existing owner, not marked complete. This is an incremental profile update, not completion of all nine profiles in Task 722.
